sideB.text:
DAR ES SALAAM
6°47'33"S 39°12'30"E

Coastal map art with a bullseye sticker circle in the center. Anchor on the compass. No search box.

The bottom edge repeats DAR ES SALAAM and the coordinates upside down.

rules: Second yellow Player card for Dar es Salaam. Port. No search.
The bullseye in the map art is the player-card upgrade slot.
notes: Same coordinates as the search card: 6°47'33"S 39°12'30"E.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
